beats.title: MYCROFT — PHASE 3
beats.subtitle: Building More AI Agents
beats.visual: Title card over an agent graph: a central MYCROFT node with five satellite agent nodes revealed in turn (MarketStructureAgent, AnomalyEventAgent, PredictionReliabilityAgent, PeerCohortBenchmarkAgent, TailRiskLiquidityAgent).

beats.title: The multi-agent foundation
beats.visual: Five framework chips revealed top-to-bottom with connector arrows — AgentConfig, SharedContext, BaseAgent, AgentResult, AgentEvent — each with a one-line gloss; then a SharedContext code card and a 'Shared communication layer' tag.

beats.title: One validated dataset
beats.visual: Four data chips — Market dataset, Schema validation, Price / return matrices, SharedContext — then the load_mycroft_data code card and a 'One validated dataset for every agent' tag.

beats.title: MarketStructureAgent
beats.visual: Notebook chart 1 (market cohesion timeline) crossfading at ~59 s to notebook chart 2 (mean within-sector correlation), over four stat cards.

beats.title: AnomalyEventAgent
beats.visual: The _robust_z code card, a 'Detecting abnormal market events' tag, four signal chips, then attribution bars (idiosyncratic 3,972 / market_wide 3,397 / sector_wide 2,267) and notebook chart 3.

beats.title: PeerCohortBenchmarkAgent
beats.visual: Cohort chips (Stock, Industry cohort n>=5, Percentile rank vs peers, Laggard / decoupling flag), a schematic peer-cohort scatter with one decoupling name highlighted, and the relative_strength_score code card.

beats.title: TailRiskLiquidityAgent
beats.visual: Five-step chain — Daily returns, Drawdown, Tail loss, Recovery, Risk tier — then the documented tier-threshold table and the tail-risk code card.

beats.title: PredictionReliabilityAgent
beats.visual: Notebook chart 9 (segment reliability with 95% ticker-clustered bootstrap intervals) crossfading at ~118 s to notebook chart 10 (reliability by sector and market regime), with the four reliability labels and the bootstrap code card.

beats.title: MycroftOrchestrator
beats.visual: Three execution stages revealed in order — stage 1 MarketStructureAgent, stage 2 the three independent analysts, stage 3 PredictionReliabilityAgent — then the self.stages code card.

beats.title: Human review queue
beats.visual: The review-queue table (EL, HAL, COF, SPGI, NOW), the six merged verdict chips, the aggregation code card, and two note cards: 'Human decision · Human rationale' and 'Advisory boundary'.

beats.title: Thirty-three checks
beats.visual: Sixteen validation items ticking on in two columns, the 33/33 card, then the end card — Dhrumil Shah / Thank you for watching — over the advisory line.
